title: Annotatio IV §.XVI: Waldenses via Lombard/Rainerius — Institution as figure/sign (rock was Christ)
pass_a_gloss: The sentence of the Waldenses of that time concerning the Sacred Eucharist, BY WHICH the genuine INTERPRETATION OF CHRIST’S INSTITUTION WORDS is given to be known even from the Pontificals’ own report — namely both from Peter Lombard, Author of that age, Sentences Book 4 Dist. 10 Qu. I, writing: There are some (the Author notes Waldenses) asserting that on the altar there is not the body or blood of Christ (understand: corporally present); But that Christ said This is my Body as the Apostle said And the Rock was Christ: they say Christ’s body is there only in the Sacrament, i.e. in the Sign; and from the younger Rainerius, making the Waldensian Sect more long-lasting or older than all others and referring it to the times of Sylvester or even of the Apostles themselves, when in the Summa on Cathars and Leonists he reports that the Waldenses believed the blessed bread is called Christ’s body in a certain Figure, as it is said And the rock was Christ.
pass_b_english: Even Pontifical reporters preserve the Waldenses’ genuine reading of the Institution words.

Lombard: some say Christ’s body is not corporally on the altar — ‘This is my Body’ as ‘the Rock was Christ’; body only in the Sacrament/Sign. Rainerius: blessed bread called body in a Figure, as the rock was Christ.
source_text: Sententia Waldensium istius temporis de S. Eucharistia, QUA VERBORUM INSTITUTIONIS CHRISTI INTERPRETATIONEM genuinam, vel ex ipsorum Pontificiorum relatione, cognoscere datur, puta tùm illius ætatis Auctoris Petri Lombardi, Sententiarum Lib. 4. Distinct. 10. Quæst. I. scribentis: Sunt quidam (Waldenses notat Auctor) asserentes in altari non esse corpus Christi vel sanguinem (intellige corporaliter præsentia); Sed ita Christum dixisse, hoc est Corpus meum, sicut Apostolus dixit, Petra autem erat Christus: dicunt ibi esse corpus Christi tantùm in Sacramento, h. e. in Signo; tum Junioris Rainerii, Sectam Waldensium omnibus aliis diuturniorem seu antiquiorem facientis, & ad tempora vel Sylvestri, vel ipsorum Apostolorum, referentis, quando in Summ. de Catharis & Leonistis refert, credidisse Waldenses, panem benedictum, in Figura quadam, dici corpus Christi, sicut dicitur, petra autem erat Christus.

lemmas.gloss: only in the Sacrament … in the Sign
